headings.part: LaTeX \part sectioning level, the coarsest one
headings.section: Sectioning level, not a UI section
headings.paragraph: LaTeX \paragraph sectioning level, not a body paragraph
headings.title: Top heading level in Typst and Markdown

toolbar.code: Label of the source-code editing mode, the opposite of Visual
toolbar.visual: Label of the rich-text editing mode, the opposite of Code
toolbar.canvas: Label of the diagram drawing mode, replaces Visual for diagram projects
toolbar.heading: Toolbar dropdown that inserts a sectioning command
toolbar.list: Toolbar dropdown that inserts a list
toolbar.linkPlaceholder: Example URL shown in an empty link field
toolbar.imagePlaceholder: Example image path shown in an empty image field
toolbar.apply: Confirms the value typed in the link or image popover

contextMenu.itemize: LaTeX itemize environment, keep the environment name recognisable
contextMenu.enumerate: LaTeX enumerate environment, keep the environment name recognisable
contextMenu.label: Inserts a \label command, not a checkpoint label

shell.diffIndex: Git index side of a diff tab, shown in parentheses after the file name
shell.diffWorkingTree: Git working tree side of a diff tab, shown in parentheses after the file name

log.open: Jumps to the source line of a compile error
log.info: Group heading for informational compile log entries
log.typesetting: Group heading for overfull and underfull box warnings

diff.stagedHeading: Compares the staged copy with HEAD
diff.workingHeading: Compares the working copy with the Git index
diff.splitView: Shows the two versions side by side
diff.unifiedView: Shows both versions in one column

history.restore: Replaces every project file with this commit's version

checkpoints.justNow: Relative time for a checkpoint less than a minute old
checkpoints.fallbackName: Placeholder name for a checkpoint with no version number yet

panel.sourceOnly: Badge saying checkpoints capture source files only, not build output

entry.restore: Restores the files in this checkpoint over the current ones

storeSummary.stored: Bytes the checkpoint store occupies on disk after deduplication
storeSummary.sourceSize: Total size of the source files the checkpoints cover
storeSummary.reclaimable: Bytes that would be freed by compacting the store

catalog.lineage: Identifier tying this store to the project that created it
catalog.pack: Column header for the pack file name
catalog.size: Column header for the pack file size
catalog.chunkCount: Column header for the number of chunks in a pack

maintenance.reset: Deletes every checkpoint for the project
maintenance.keepLatest: Deletes every checkpoint except the newest one

table.selectSize: Shown before the user hovers a cell in the table size grid

visual.suggestionRemove: Proofreading fix that deletes the flagged text
visual.suggestionReplace: Proofreading fix that swaps the flagged text
visual.grammarAndStyle: Category of a grammar or style finding
visual.endOfDocument: Marker printed under the last line of the visual editor

inlineAi.retry: Asks the AI for the edit again

citations.trigger: Opens a picker that inserts a citation from the project bibliography

preview.loading: Shown while the PDF viewer chunk downloads

search.find: Placeholder and accessible name of the search field in the editor find bar
search.replace: Placeholder and accessible name of the replacement field, not the action
search.replaceAction: Button that replaces the current match only
search.replaceAllAction: Short button label next to Replace, replaces every match
search.invalid: Shown in place of a match count when the regular expression does not parse
search.matchPosition: Which match the cursor is on out of the total, for example 3 of 12
search.matchCount_one: Match count shown when the cursor is not on a match; total may read 2000+
search.matchCount_other: Match count shown when the cursor is not on a match; total may read 2000+

spellcheck.ignore: Short card button that ignores the flagged word in the current project
spellcheck.suggestionRemove: Applies a proofreading fix that deletes the flagged text
spellcheck.suggestionReplace: Quoted replacement text offered as a proofreading fix, quotes included
spellcheck.suggestionAdd: Applies a proofreading fix that inserts the quoted text

completion.label: Autocomplete hint marking the entry as a LaTeX cross-reference label
completion.citation: Autocomplete hint marking the entry as a bibliography citation key
completion.environment: Autocomplete hint for an environment that ships with LaTeX itself
completion.documentEnvironment: Autocomplete hint for an environment defined in the open document

macro.plain: Autocomplete hint for a macro defined in the document that takes no arguments

command.title: Autocomplete hint for the LaTeX command that sets the document title
command.author: Autocomplete hint for the LaTeX command that sets the author
command.date: Autocomplete hint for the LaTeX command that sets the date
command.label: Autocomplete hint for the LaTeX command that defines a cross-reference target
command.ref: Autocomplete hint for the LaTeX command that refers to a label
command.cite: Autocomplete hint for the LaTeX command that cites a bibliography entry
command.section: Autocomplete hint for a sectioning command
command.subsection: Autocomplete hint for a sectioning command
command.subsubsection: Autocomplete hint for a sectioning command
command.underline: Autocomplete hint for the command that underlines text
command.footnote: Autocomplete hint for the command that adds a footnote
command.url: Autocomplete hint for the command that typesets a web address

snippet.label: Slash-command hint for inserting a cross-reference target
snippet.bold: Slash-command hint for inserting bold text
snippet.italic: Slash-command hint for inserting italic text

block.title: Chip label over a preserved LaTeX block that sets the document title
block.date: Chip label over a preserved LaTeX block that sets the date
block.figure: Chip label over a preserved LaTeX figure block
block.table: Chip label over a preserved LaTeX table block
block.author: Chip label over a preserved LaTeX block listing the authors
block.comment: Chip label over a preserved LaTeX comment line
block.editSource: Opens the exact LaTeX of the block for editing in place

inline.edit: Small button that opens the exact inline LaTeX for editing
